title: Response-blind face-interpolated internal-gradient amplitude test
question: Can the existing B9 terminal and bulk one-sided storage reconstructions support a smaller, parameter-free face-interpolated interface slope that improves qi across width and regime while preserving qH and hydrostatics?

candidate.name: FACE_INTERPOLATED_PIECEWISE_LINEAR_GRADIENT
candidate.interpretation: Treat the B9 terminal and bulk one-sided reconstructed slopes as control-volume-centered gradient proxies and linearly interpolate them to their shared interface using opposite center-to-face distances.

reference_diagnostic.K_ref_bar: arithmetic mean of Reference endpoint interface K

outputs: BASE and FACE qi bias, MAE, RMS, max_abs, sign mismatches and correlation
BASE and FACE exact interval-effective slope error relative to s_ref
fraction intervals delta_face has same sign as delta_ref
fraction intervals FACE slope closer to s_ref than BASE
amplitude ratio |delta_face|/|delta_central| as a pure geometry diagnostic

support_rules.moving: For each width in WT_RISE and WT_FALL, FACE qi must have strictly lower RMS and MAE than BASE by more than 1e-12 and no greater sign-mismatch count.
support_rules.hold: For each width in WT_HOLD, FACE qi RMS and MAE must be no greater than BASE within 1e-12 and no greater sign-mismatch count.

decisions.FACE_INTERPOLATED_GRADIENT_STATIC_CANDID: All hard gates pass; all four moving cases support and both HOLD cases are noninferior.
decisions.FACE_INTERPOLATED_GRADIENT_MOVING_ONLY: All hard gates pass; all four moving cases support but at least one HOLD case fails.
decisions.FACE_INTERPOLATED_GRADIENT_MIXED: All hard gates pass but moving support is not uniform.
decisions.C4N_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Any hard authority or numerical gate fails.

boundaries: C4N does not use C4M response magnitudes to choose a coefficient.
The distance weight d/(B+d) is fixed by geometry before execution.
Positive static support does not authorize propagated dynamics.
No direction switch, fitted blend, Hdot term, memory state or clipping is allowed.

pre_execution_operationalisation.interval_effective_slope: For Reference use s_ref=1-qi_ref/Kref_bar. For BASE and FACE use s=1-q_interval/Ki_bar, where q_interval is the trapezoidal endpoint flux and Ki_bar is the arithmetic mean of unchanged B9 endpoint Ki. This makes q=Kbar*(1-s) exact.
pre_execution_operationalisation.endpoint_geometry: The frozen endpoint face slope s_face=(B*a_t+d*b_bulk)/(B+d) and endpoint delta_face=d/(B+d)*(b_bulk-a_t) are secondary geometry diagnostics. They are not substituted for the exact interval-effective slope in primary comparisons.
pre_execution_operationalisation.geometry_ratio: When |b_bulk-a_t|>1e-12, report |delta_face_endpoint|/|delta_central_endpoint|=d/B. Intervals/endpoints below that numerical floor are omitted from the ratio only.
pre_execution_operationalisation.zero_floor_role: Numerical guard only; not hydrological acceptance.
